name: Suchismita Ghoshal

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Suchismita Ghoshal is a poet and writer from Malda, West Bengal. Her poetry books include Fields of Sonnet, Poetries in Quarantine and Emotions & Tantrums. She also writes collaboratively: Ukiyoto publishes Euphonious Echoes, a volume she shares with Shakil Kalam.

In ‘WHAT COULD I EVEN WRITE ABOUT THIS EVENING?’, an ordinary sunset opens into a reckoning with working life away from home. Tea, passing traffic and the imagined waiting of parents measure what professional ambition leaves little time to notice. The poem's conversational questions hold the tension between becoming self-supporting and losing the ability to inhabit the present.
